name: ratemaking-oh
title: General liability ratemaking from one Ohio filing
summary: Redo a real general liability rate indication filed in Ohio: development factors, ultimate losses, trend, loss ratios, the indicated rate change, Ohio's loss cost multiplier and the places where the exhibits disagree.
description: Each task gives the AI the filed documents of one real general liability rate filing made in Ohio, as text, and asks it to recompute, check or read exact values: age-to-age and age-to-ultimate factors, chain-ladder and Bornhuetter-Ferguson ultimates, trend factors and regressions, loss ratios and credibility, the indicated rate change and the loss cost multiplier, or the places where the exhibits disagree with each other or with their own notes. Every answer follows from the printed numbers and the formulas the filing states. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

upstream.name: Ohio Department of Insurance, public filing records
upstream.by: the filers, through the Ohio Department of Insurance

families.name: Age-to-age factors
families.what: Development factors read from the right triangle, with evaluation dates turned into development ages.

families.name: Factor averages
families.what: Volume-weighted and simple averages of development factors over the right number of years.

families.name: Age-to-ultimate factors
families.what: Cumulative factors built from the selected factors and the selected tail.

families.name: Ultimate losses
families.what: Chain-ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson and selected ultimates by accident quarter and accident year.

families.name: Trend
families.what: Loss and premium trend factors and trended amounts, and trends fitted by exponential regression.

families.name: Loss ratios
families.what: Attritional, ALAE and excess loss ratios, and class group relativities with their credibility.

families.name: Rate indication
families.what: The countrywide indicated rate change, with the weights that reproduce the printed figures.

families.name: Loss cost multiplier
families.what: Ohio's expected loss ratio, loss cost multiplier and rate level changes.

families.name: Checking the filing
families.what: Where the exhibits disagree with each other or with their own notes, and where they tie out.
